payload.title: runtime config path spelled twice
payload.body: The host runtime config's path rule ($AGENT_RUNTIME_CONFIG, else ~/.cratylus.json) is declared in both forge (deploy/runtime-config.ts) and runtime (runtime-config.ts), and refusal messages in event-tap/dispatch.ts and plan/reading.ts spell it again as literal text. forge may depend on runtime, so the rule can have one home the others import. Predates the per-harness stanza work.
